name: Badge
summary: A small count or dot marker, plus plan, rank, session, New and Beta chips, ribbons and the Status badges, all in two sizes.
highlights: Notification counts, unread dots, plan and session chips
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-badge> — defined once, imported unchanged by React and Vue. The DS V3 Badge is a family: `count` renders a number pill on the top-right of a wrapped child (capped by `overflowCount` as N+, kept at 0 with `showZero`); `dot` renders a bare marker in one of three colours (`status` default, disabled or active); `color` overrides the count colour. For a standalone state label (Published, Failed) use the Status badge component. Shadow-DOM CSS themed only by --aha-* tokens; the pill scales in on a persistent node. Zero drift — the same element, not two look-alikes.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render. React (< 19) consumes it via a thin ref wrapper; Vue binds the custom element natively. The primitive is defined once in @ahaslides-product/design.

spec.label: Count bubble
spec.value: height 18 · min-width 18 · radius pill · padding 0 6 · scales in

spec.label: Count colour
spec.value: only default and primary. Black (default, no status) for every count: tabs, filters, inbox, totals · Vivid Pink (status="primary") only for a new count that needs attention now (unread notifications on the bell, new responses since you last looked) · at most one Vivid Pink count per screen

spec.label: On a child
spec.value: floats to the child's top-right, 1px container-colour ring

spec.label: Dot
spec.value: 8×8, no label. Colour by status: default icon-strong #1A1A1A, disabled icon-disabled #B5B5B5, active icon-active #E70E68

spec.label: Text
spec.value: Plus Jakarta SemiBold 600, 11/18, #FFFFFF (count, ribbon). Chip label 14px (default) or 12px (sm)

spec.label: Default colour
spec.value: count → error #1A1A1A (black); dot → default #1A1A1A; ribbon → primary #E70E68. Vivid Pink count: status="primary" (white number on #E70E68), only for a new count that needs attention now

spec.label: Overflow / zero
spec.value: count > overflowCount → N+; 0 hides unless showZero

spec.label: Ribbon
spec.value: corner banner over a wrapped card; 22px tall, radius 4, triangular fold; placement start/end

spec.label: Plan chip
spec.value: preset (free·edu·essential·pro·enterprise); size default: height 28 · radius sm 6 · padding 0 12 · label 14/20 semibold 600; size sm: height 20 · radius xs 4 · padding 0 4 · label 12 regular 400 · no icon; grey fill (gray-30), enterprise Vivid Pink 5% fill (bg-accent); cycle monthly/yearly

spec.label: Rank chip
spec.value: leaderboard 1st–4th, leading system-medal glyph; size sm by default (20px, radius xs, 12px icon), size="default" is 28px with a 16px icon; 1st is grey (gray-30)

spec.label: Session chip
spec.value: "Session N" chip, size sm by default: grey fill (gray-30), default text; label from `session` / slotted text

spec.label: New and Beta
spec.value: size sm by default (20px · padding 0 4 · 12px label regular 400 · radius xs). New: bg-accent #FEF3F7 fill + text-link-hover #DB005B label (4.65:1, WebAIM Normal Text AA); Beta: grey fill (gray-30 #F1F1F1) + text-default #1A1A1A. Labels "New" and "Beta"

spec.label: Status badge
spec.value: <aha-status-badge> is shown with the chips and takes the same `size`: default 28px (padding 8, 14px semibold, radius sm, 16px icon) · sm 20px (padding 4, 12px regular 400, radius xs, 12px icon). Its own spec is in the Status badge section

spec.label: Chip size
spec.value: default 28px · 14px label semibold · radius sm · 16px icon · padding 12; sm 20px · 12px label regular 400 · radius xs · 12px icon · padding 4; plan defaults to default, rank, session and New / Beta to sm

props.name: count
props.desc: The number shown in the bubble; 0 hides it unless showZero

props.name: overflowCount
props.desc: Cap; above it renders as N+ (alias: max)

props.name: showZero
props.desc: Keep the bubble visible when count is 0

props.name: dot
props.desc: Render a bare marker, no number; colour from `status` (default · disabled · active)

props.name: status
props.type: default | primary (count) · default | disabled | active (dot) · ribbon: success | processing | error | warning | default | primary
props.desc: A count is black by default; `primary` (Vivid Pink) only for a new count needing attention now, at most one per screen. The old count values success, error, warning and default are deprecated aliases of black, and processing of primary. On a `dot` it picks one of three colours: default, disabled, active; a dot on a notification icon is always active (pink)

props.name: text
props.desc: Label for a ribbon, or a plan/rank/session/kind chip

props.name: color
props.desc: Custom colour overriding the semantic default

props.name: ribbon
props.desc: Wrap the slotted child (a card) with a corner ribbon banner; `text` is the label, colour from color/status (default primary)

props.name: placement
props.desc: Ribbon corner: end = top-right (default), start = top-left

props.name: plan
props.desc: Plan preset chip; grey fill, enterprise on a Vivid Pink 5% fill; no icon. Size default unless `size` is set

props.name: cycle
props.desc: Appended to a plan chip's default label (e.g. "Pro · Yearly")

props.name: rank
props.desc: Leaderboard rank chip with a leading system-medal glyph; size sm unless `size` is set

props.name: session
props.desc: Renders a "Session N" chip on a grey fill; the value is N (slotted content / `text` overrides the label). Size sm unless `size` is set

props.name: kind
props.desc: New tag: Vivid Pink 5% fill (bg-accent #FEF3F7) with Darker Pink label (text-link-hover #DB005B, 4.65:1). Beta tag: grey fill (gray-30), default text; label "New" / "Beta"; size sm unless `size` is set

props.name: size
props.desc: Chip size: default is 28px tall with a 14px label and 16px icon; sm is 20px with 4px side padding, a 12px regular label and a 12px icon. Also accepted by `<aha-status-badge>`

whenToUse.when: a count or presence marker attached to another element (a bell, a tab, an avatar). A dot on a notification icon is always the active (pink) dot; default and disabled dots are for neutral marks next to text

black (the default) for every count (tabs, filters, inbox, totals); Vivid Pink (status="primary") only for a new count that needs attention now, such as unread notifications on the bell or new responses since you last looked; at most one Vivid Pink count per screen
something new to try: a slide type, a feature, a menu item. At most one New per area, and remove it once the thing is no longer new
a feature that is in beta
a standalone semantic state label (Published, Generating, Failed) in a list or header: use `<aha-status-badge>`, not a count or dot
a standalone label/keyword chip with text but no status semantics

opinion.note: A count/dot marks another element — wrap the element it belongs to so the pill anchors to its top-right. Keep counts meaningful; cap large numbers with overflowCount so the bubble stays small. A dot takes only default, disabled or active. A standalone state label is `<aha-status-badge>`, shown with the chips and sized by the same switch; its rules are in the Status badge section. Counts are black unless a new count needs attention now: then one Vivid Pink count per screen, never several.
opinion.dsv3: COVERED — enumerated from the DS V3 Badge component-set taxonomy: Badge/Count, Badge/Dot, Badge/Text, Badge/On-Icon, Badge/On-Image, Badge/Dot-On-Text, Badge/Ribbon — i.e. the family carries a count pill, a bare dot, placement over a wrapped icon/image/text child, AND a corner ribbon banner wrapping a card. antd Badge conventions supply the count sizing (18px bubble, 8×8 dot, 11/18 SemiBold), overflowCount N+, showZero, the count status set (success/processing/error/default/warning), and Badge.Ribbon (a corner banner, 22px tall, radius-xs on the outer corner, a darkened triangular fold, placement start/end, colour default primary). Token layer: count/dot default color-error, count status→color-success/warning/primary(processing)/text-tertiary(default), dot→icon-strong/icon-disabled/icon-active, ribbon default color-primary + radius-xs fold, radius-pill, text-inverse, bg-container ring. The measured component standard has no badge cell — a deliberate, documented extension, not a measured match.
